data.content_ref: inline:The target fails to propose a substantive relation as required by the problem context. Instead of naming a specific kind of relation (e.g., dependence, reduction) and stating what it is refuted if, the text provides a narrative summary of the 'Pragmatic Wager' and its conditions. The phrase 'depends on' appears only as part of the descriptive content of the wager itself, not as the explicit naming of the relation between the isolated node and its neighbourhood in the format demanded (Relation Kind + Refutation Condition). Consequently, it does not establish the required structural link between endpoints.
